attribution: Images read from Earth Search's Sentinel-2 Collection 1 Level-2A archive

bands.image: TCI, ESA's true-colour image (B4, B3, B2, fixed scaling), 10 m
bands.index: NDCI (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4), 20 m, core pixels that were clear

method.scenes: usable scenes only (the test's 80% clear rule); cloudy scenes have no image

claim: True-colour pictures of the satellite scenes the readings came from, and the index on the pixels each reading used. Pictures, not measurements of algae or toxins, and not swimming advice. A scene without an image was too cloudy to read.
